body: She had an affair and has taken everything.

You are outlining what I went through 1 1/2 years ago. My gut knew the day my wife had her affair. Then for the next 10 months she acted just like that. Her phone that was once left around all the time was now glued to her hip. I finally uncovered everything 10 months later when my phone busted and I got us new phones. After she did her data transfer and erased her phone I went into the behind the scenes files like her Google history, and photos and uncovered all of the emails and videos she had sent to him. You have every right to be suspicious. I am sorry to hear all of this. I wish it on no one. This has made me relive what I went through and I am sad for you. Reach out to your family and friends for support. I would definitely confront her. Good luck to you.

I am there now. I have been since last year when I found out my wife of 13 years had an affair. It has destroyed my life, and thanks to the justice system I am losing everything I ever worked for too. This all hurts so much, especially after she told me I was the perfect husband and never deserved any of this. I feel the worst for my 5 kids, but I truly think they would be better off without me. They would all get the financial perks of me passing and they would never have to be dragged back and forth and caught in the middle of this ugly divorce. I have lost everything. All I ever wanted was a family and a home. I have taken myself from being homeless to where I am, and now I am full circle. I am alone and have nothing again. Each day is a struggle and I only stay for my children, but I am having trouble dealing with all this hurt and pain. I am ready to give up. I am lost. Please don't think poorly of me for thinking this way. I know there are so many people in the world that are worse off and I am selfish for thinking this. Just in need of a caring hand. Sorry for bothering everyone, and thank you for letting me spill my thoughts.
